verdict.rationale: The installer writes skills into the repo as ordinary, editable files, and a hands-on probe confirmed a selectively installed SKILL.md landed in ./.claude/skills/tdd/ and read back cleanly, so reading every file after install is supported. The pre-install half is weak: users can pick which skills to install, but no documented step lists a skill's files, instructions or scripts before installing. The plugin route also ships a read-only, self-updating bundle, which makes post-install review less stable. missing for 10: a documented pre-install listing or preview of each skill's files and scripts, an explicit inventory of what each skill adds, independent corroboration of the review workflow.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can review exactly what instructions and scripts a skill will add — list contents before installing and read every file afterward

citations.quote: It writes the skills into your repo as ordinary files you own and can edit.
Pick the skills and agents you use. The installer writes editable files into your project.
